anchors.description: Blue-rimmed round dinner plate lying flat on the granite counter, left of the cup platter
anchors.visible_evidence: Both lateral rim extremes of the plate are visible against the countertop; the plate lies flat so the leftmost-rightmost rim points span its diameter.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Dinner vs salad plate; US plate diameters 7.5-11 in (0.19-0.28 m), so diameter taken as 0.24 m.

anchors.description: Large round plate/platter with red-patterned rim holding stacked white cups, on the counter
anchors.visible_evidence: Left and right rim of the plate are visible in front of the cup stack; the plate is flat so the rim extremes span its diameter.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Could be an 11-13 in dinner/serving plate; diameter interval 0.24-0.36 m covers 10-14 in.

anchors.description: Black drip coffee maker standing on the counter to the right of the white pitcher
anchors.visible_evidence: Left and right vertical body edges of the black appliance are visible above the counter at the same height, spanning its front-face width.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Typical 12-cup drip coffee maker body width 0.22-0.30 m; machine rotation could make the front-face span slightly wider than the true width.

anchors.description: White ceramic pitcher/carafe standing on the counter in front of the white counter appliance
anchors.visible_evidence: Rim at the top and base at the counter are both visible; the top rim sits directly above the base so the segment equals the pitcher height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Ceramic pitcher or water-filter jug; typical heights 0.20-0.30 m, taken as 0.25 m.
